questions.q: What is the central message of Jobs' three stories?
options: Follow your curiosity and heart, love your work, and don't waste limited time
Drop out of school early, since formal education blocks real creativity
Build a company quickly, then hand control to professional managers
Trust experts and doctors, avoid risk, and secure a stable career first
questions.explain: The stories on connecting dots, love and loss, and death all urge following your heart and not living someone else's life.

questions.q: How did Jobs get food after dropping out of Reed?
options: He sold hand-drawn calligraphy posters
He borrowed from his parents each week
He returned Coke bottles for five-cent deposits
He worked in the college cafeteria
questions.explain: He returned Coke bottles for the five-cent deposits and walked seven miles for a weekly meal at the Hare Krishna temple.

questions.q: Why did his biological mother finally sign the adoption papers?
options: His parents promised he would go to college
She was paid by his adoptive parents
A court ordered her to sign
The lawyer and his wife backed out
questions.explain: She relented when his parents promised that he would go to college.

questions.q: What happened after Apple hired a manager to run the company with Jobs?
options: The board sided with the other executive and he was fired
He was pushed out when the board backed the new manager
He sold his shares and left the company voluntarily
He stayed on by reconciling differences with the board
questions.explain: Jobs says their visions diverged, the board sided with the other person, and he was out of Apple.

questions.q: What would Jobs most likely say about being fired from Apple?
options: It was ultimately good, freeing him to be creative again
It was a painful mistake that took years of therapy to overcome
It showed the board had been right to doubt his management
It made him lose interest in computers and turn to teaching
questions.explain: He called it the best thing that could have happened, leading to NeXT, Pixar and his return to Apple.
